'''Clue scroll (elite)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (elite)|elite]] [[Treasure Trails]]. A [[frost nagua]] or the [[Amoxliatl]] in the [[Ruins of Tapoyauik]] must be defeated. Players who have completed the quest should walk east down the chain to quell the monster.
